text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it's almost closing time... 
Could you please finish reading in your 
room...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it that time already? I'm so sorry 
for causing you such trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, I completely 
forgot to eat lunch."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san has been completely focused 
since this morning, after all."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, I understand. I often forget to eat 
and sleep when reading, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if I absorb nourishment from the 
books, so I never really feel hungry, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but please make sure you eat properly. 
And don't forget to take breaks, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you very much for your 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Not getting hungry when deeply focused 
on a book sounds like something you could 
use for a diet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have gained some weight recently, so if 
I can use this to prevent unnecessary 
snacking...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ardan came up with a 
reading diet, and it was a brilliant 
success.
